title: Musiał i Wspólnicy
summary: A website for a Poznań-based law firm.
portfolioImageAlt: Musiał i Wspólnicy homepage with a city panorama and the headline “Technology, Environment, US”.

blocks.text:
Musiał i Wspólnicy is a Poznań-based law firm specialising in services for businesses, companies and institutions.

I designed a website that highlights the firm’s roots in Poznań and its ties to the city. Bold typography, strong contrasts and animation give the site a distinctive look that suits a modern law firm.

The implementation also included analytics without cookies, avoiding intrusive banners and pop-ups.
